items.english: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
items.draft: Moenie toiletwater, water van doeke, of water van die was van 'n siek persoon of van diere by 'n hergebruikplan insluit nie. Moenie water hergebruik wat skadelike chemikalieë bevat nie.
items.backtranslation: Do not include toilet water, water from cloths, or water from washing a sick person or from animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water that contains harmful chemicals.
items.problem: 'water van doeke' reads as 'water from cloths' rather than nappies, and 'of van diere' leaves unclear that water used to wash animals is excluded, weakening a greywater safety exclusion.
items.corrected: Moenie toiletwater, water van luiers, of water waarmee 'n siek persoon of diere gewas is, by 'n hergebruikplan insluit nie. Moenie water hergebruik wat skadelike chemikalieë bevat nie.
